briefing: Markets were mildly risk-on today with NASDAQ +0.6% and S&P 500 +0.5%, but the signal wasn't strong enough to warrant new buys. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 threshold for deploying into new positions, so we're holding the current 7-position portfolio and letting existing profit targets and stop-losses do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was below the threshold needed for a meaningful new position, so holding that cash in reserve — rather than forcing a small, low-conviction buy — preserves flexibility for a better setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是暫時持有、等待良好時機才動用的現金。今日現金餘額未達到建立有意義新倉位的門檻，與其勉強買入信心不足的小額部位，不如保留現金彈性，等待更明確的進場機會。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ up 0.6% and the S&P 500 up 0.5%, reflecting a mildly constructive but not decisive risk-on tone. Without a sharper move or high-conviction multi-signal setup among screened candidates, there wasn't a clear catalyst to justify committing fresh capital. The portfolio remains well-positioned with gains intact across its existing holdings.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚，納斯達克指數上升0.6%，標普500指數上升0.5%，市場氣氛偏向溫和的風險偏好，但力度不足以構成明確的進場訊號。由於篩選名單中未出現足夠強烈的多重訊號組合，暫時沒有充分理由投入新資金。現有持倉表現穩健，維持不動為宜。
